stages.description: 只修明确问题，不做像素残差补丁

provenance.description: Human-guided curve construction with large connected flats. No v4 brush data or reference-pixel segmentation is imported.
provenance.referenceRole: display and human visual reference only

audit.method: assistant-authored semantic curves and region fills; no image analysis
limitations: This is a simplified redraw, not a pixel-faithful restoration.
Semantic paths are authored for this reference; a new reference needs a new model-authored plan.
The built-in replay is pre-authored, not live model inference.
